verdict.rationale: Riveter offers a scrape endpoint that turns a URL into parseable text, and the API claims it can extract data from complicated websites using AI agents that interpret pages the way a person would. However, nothing explicitly documents JavaScript execution or SPA rendering, and the documented output is parsed text rather than rendered HTML. Missing for 10: explicit JS/headless-browser rendering of SPAs, returning fully rendered HTML output, wait/render controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
